events.title: Investor (Provisional) subclass 162 and State/Territory Sponsored Investor subclass 165 visas commence
events.description: Schedule 2 of the Migration Amendment Regulations 2002 (No. 10) (SR 2002 No. 348, made 19 Dec 2002) inserts Subclass 162 Investor (Provisional) and Subclass 165 State/Territory Sponsored Investor (Provisional), with a 'designated investment' of AUD1,500,000 (162) or AUD750,000 (165) and the residence subclasses that follow; in force 1 March 2003. The 1992 'first version of the Business Skills programme' (FOI release) is kept as a separate, earlier account of the wider programme; whether a pre-2003 investment-linked visa should count as this programme's start was not checked.
events.quote: on 1 March 2003 — regulation 4 and Schedule 2.

events.title: Belarus law in force with a permanent-residence ground for foreign investors (EUR 150,000)
events.description: Law No. 105-З of 4 January 2010 (published 20 January 2010) lists among grounds for a permanent residence permit foreign investors who invested at least EUR 150,000 in Belarus (art. 53, original text); the law entered into force six months after publication, on 21 July 2010 per the National Register card. The predecessor law of 3 June 1993 (repealed by art. 75) was not read, so an earlier investor ground cannot be excluded.

21.07.2010

events.title: Azerbaijan Cabinet Decision 102 sets the investment amount that grounds temporary residence
events.description: The State Migration Service reports that Cabinet of Ministers Decision 102 of 30 June 2009 approved the regulations on temporary residence permits and defined the investment amount in the economy (and bank deposit amount) that grounds a temporary residence permit; Decision 126 of 18 August 2009 set them at AZN 500,000 and AZN 50,000. Date is the decision's date (in-force date not stated); the decision text was not read (refworld copy behind a bot check). The decision implemented a law of 24 June 2008 amending legislative acts, which may have created the investment ground (not read). Predates the 2013 Migration Code.
events.quote: on defining of the investment amount put in the economy of the Republic of Azerbaijan and deposit amount at Azerbaijan banks giving base on granting permission for temporary residence

events.title: Azerbaijan sets the temporary-residence investment at AZN 500,000 and deposit at AZN 50,000
events.description: Cabinet Decision 126 of 18 August 2009 amends Decision 102: investment in the economy AZN 500,000; deposit in an Azerbaijani bank AZN 50,000 (as reported by the State Migration Service). In-force date not stated.
events.quote: investment amount put in the economy of the Republic of Azerbaijan is determined in the amount of 500.000 AZN and deposit amount at any of Azerbaijan banks in the amount of 50.000 AZN

events.title: VZAE names substantial cantonal fiscal interests as a ground for residence permits
events.description: The ordinance of 24 October 2007 (in force 1 January 2008, with the Foreign Nationals Act, art. 30(1)(b)) lets cantons grant a short-stay or residence permit to protect important public interests, listing 'substantial cantonal fiscal interests' (art. 32(1)(c)); this is the ground used for wealthy non-working non-EU/EFTA nationals. The predecessor ordinance (BVO 1986, version 2006) had no explicit fiscal ground, only art. 36 'important reasons' for other non-working foreigners. In-force date from art. 92.
events.quote: erhebliche kantonale fiskalische Interessen;

events.title: BVO 1986: residence for other non-working foreigners only 'when important reasons require'
events.description: Before the VZAE, the Ordinance on Limiting the Number of Foreigners (in force 1 November 1986, art. 59) allowed residence permits for non-working foreigners other than pupils, patients, retirees and foster children only 'wenn wichtige Gründe es gebieten' (art. 36), with no explicit fiscal-interest ground; cantons could set stricter conditions (art. 37). Read in the version of 12 December 2006. Whether cantons used art. 36 for wealthy foreigners is not stated in the text.
events.quote: werden, wenn wichtige Gründe es gebieten.

events.title: Cayman Islands creates the Certificate of Direct Investment (Law 15 of 2010)
events.description: The Immigration (Amendment) Law, 2010 inserts sections 37A and 37B: a 25-year certificate to reside and work in a licensed employment-generating business in which the holder has invested the prescribed amount. Passed 28 April 2010, assented 7 May 2010, published in Extraordinary Gazette No. 27 of 13 May 2010; the text states no commencement date, so the publication date is used.
events.quote: issue a Certificate of Direct Investment valid for twenty-five years

events.title: First Certificate of Direct Investment requirements: six million dollars net worth, 2.4 million invested
events.description: The Immigration (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations, 2010 (made 11 May 2010, published 19 May 2010) insert reg 14A: personal net worth of at least six million dollars and an investment of at least two million four hundred thousand dollars in an employment-generating business; issue fee 20,000. The net worth requirement was deleted in 2012 and the investment later set at one million dollars.
events.quote: sum of at least two million four hundred thousand dollars in an employment generating business

events.title: Cayman 25-year residential certificate for persons of independent means available from 1 January 2004
events.description: Section 33 of the Immigration Law, 2003 (Law 34 of 2003) created a 25-year Residential Certificate for Retirees for persons of independent means who invest a prescribed sum in developed residential real estate and other local investments. Law 35 of 2006 renamed it the Residency Certificate for Persons of Independent Means and treats certificates under s. 33 as granted from 1 January 2004. The original 2003 enactment and its commencement clause were not read; the date is the one Law 35 of 2006 gives for the first grants (also the changeover date in the 2006 Revision's transitional provisions). The amounts were prescribed by the Immigration Regulations, 2004, in effect from 18 May 2004.
events.quote: granted between 1st January, 2004 and the commencement of the new Law

events.title: Retirees' certificate becomes the Residency Certificate for Persons of Independent Means; minimum age 55 dropped
events.description: Law 35 of 2006 repeals and replaces s. 33: any person of independent means aged 18 or over may apply for the 25-year Residency Certificate for Persons of Independent Means (previously age 55, or lower at the Board's discretion, and no dependants under 16). It also repeals the separate Residential Certificate for Entrepreneurs and Investors. Date is the publication date (Extraordinary Gazette No. 27 of 21 December 2006, also the day of assent); the commencement date is not stated in the text.
events.quote: valid for twenty-five years and renewable thereafter at the discretion of the Chief Immigration Officer

events.title: Cyprus Aliens and Immigration Regulations: Regulation 6(2) discretion to grant an immigration permit
events.description: Regulation 6(2) of the Aliens and Immigration Regulations 1972 (K.D.P. 242/72) lets the Minister grant an immigration permit to a migrant who does not belong to any Regulation 5 category, if he sees fit and the migration does not harm the inhabitants. The fast-track investor permanent residence is issued under this regulation (2023 criteria, para 1.1). Date is the gazette publication date; no in-force date is stated.
events.quote: δέν ανήκει εις μίαν τών έν τω κανονισμώ 5 εκτιθεμένων κατηγοριών,

events.title: Georgia's residence permit for owners of real property (USD 35,000) takes effect
events.description: Law No 3602 of 8 May 2015 adds to art. 15 of the Law on the Legal Status of Aliens a short-term residence permit for owners of non-agricultural real property worth over USD 35,000 (and a D5 visa). Art. 3(1) puts the law into force on publication, except provisions unrelated to this permit; publication on the matsne website was 15/05/2015 (geo-matsne-law-3602-2015-page). The consolidated version of 20/03/2015 (geo-matsne-aliens-law-2015-03) has no such ground. Legal basis: the 2014 Law, in force 1 September 2014.
events.location: art. 3(1), PDF p. 8 (in force); art. 1(9), PDF p. 6 (the new subparagraph)
events.quote: საქართველოს კანონის 70-ე მუხლის მე-2 პუნქტის „ა“ ქვეპუნქტისა, ამოქმედდეს გამოქვეყნებისთანავე.

events.title: France's 'passeport talent' card, incl. the economic investor category, takes effect
events.description: The multi-year residence cards created by art. 17 of the law of 7 March 2016 (L. 313-17 to L. 313-24, incl. the passeport talent for a foreigner making a direct economic investment, 7° of L. 313-20) enter into force on 1 November 2016. Art. 67 II of the law set entry into force at a date fixed by Conseil d'Etat decree, at the latest 1 November 2016 (fra-an-ta683-2016); this government circular annex gives the date. The decree itself (n° 2016-1456 of 28 Oct 2016) was not read.
events.location: PDF p. 26, section 1.3.2.1 'Entrée en vigueur du nouveau dispositif'
events.quote: La carte de séjour pluriannuelle, qui entre en vigueur au 1er novembre 2016, s’appliquera aux dossiers pour lesquels aucune décision n’aura été prise à cette date.

events.title: Parliament adopts the law creating the 'passeport talent' (incl. investors); in force by 1 Nov 2016 at the latest
events.description: Final text of the bill on the rights of foreigners (promulgated as loi n° 2016-274 of 7 March 2016). Art. 17 creates L. 313-20, whose 7° grants the passeport talent card to a foreigner who makes a direct economic investment in France; art. 67 II puts art. 17 into force at a date set by decree, at the latest 1 November 2016.
events.location: p. 1 (date); art. 17, L. 313-20 7°, PDF p. 17; art. 67 II, PDF p. 63
events.quote: entrent en vigueur à compter d’une date fixée par décret en Conseil d’État, et au plus tard le 1er novembre 2016.

events.title: Lithuania's Law on the Legal Status of Aliens takes effect, with residence for foreign company owners
events.description: Law No IX-2206 of 29 April 2004, in force 30 April 2004, art. 45(1)(1): temporary residence (one year) for a foreigner who registers a company in Lithuania as owner or co-owner of at least 10% of its capital or votes, where his presence is necessary for the company. No minimum investment in the 2004 wording; the EUR amounts (EUR 14,000/28,000; EUR 260,000 route) came by later amendments (XII-2609 of 2016 and earlier, pre-2014 amendments not identified). Matches the Commission's dating of the Lithuanian scheme to 2004.
events.quote: Įsigalioja 2004-04-30

events.title: Government bill: residence for owners of real property is a new ground
events.description: The Government's explanatory memorandum to the 2014 Law on Foreigners states that art. 54, allowing temporary residence for use of real property of a certain value owned in Montenegro, is a novelty of the bill.
events.quote: elanom 54, kao novina Predlogom zakona, predvidena je moguenost odobravanja privremenog boravka strancu radi korigeenja nepolcretnosti, odredene vrijednosti, koju stranac posjeduje u Cmoj Gori

events.title: Montenegro's 2014 Law on Foreigners applies, with residence for owners of real property
events.description: The Law on Foreigners adopted 16 December 2014 (Sl. list CG 56/14) provides temporary residence for disposing of rights to real property owned in Montenegro (art. 37(1)(8), art. 54; one-year permit; the Government to set value conditions). Art. 145: in force on the eighth day after publication in the Službeni list, applied from 1 April 2015 (when the 2008 Law on Foreigners ceased, art. 144). The publication date is not in stored documents, so the stated application date is used.
events.location: art. 145, PDF p. 48; art. 54, PDF p. 16
events.quote: Ovaj zakon stupa na snagu osmog dana od dana objavljivanja u „Sluibenom listu Crne Gore", a prinnjenjivate se od 1. aprila 2015. godine.

events.title: Parliament adopts the Law on Foreigners with a real-property residence ground
events.description: Promulgation decree of 19.12.2014: the Parliament adopted the Law on Foreigners on 16 December 2014.

aus-business-skills-investor: whether a pre-2003 investment visa (before the provisional subclass 162/165 structure of 1 March 2003) counts as this programme's start was not checked; the 1992 Business Skills launch event (FOI release) remains as an account of the wider programme.

brb-serp: stored texts (Immigration Department SEP page 2026; Business Barbados article by LEX Caribbean 2025) give no start date; the article says 'The SERP programme is governed by policy not specific enabling legislation', so there is no founding text, only a policy under s.13(3) Immigration Act Cap. 190. No Barbados Gazette notice, budget speech or Cabinet statement introducing the SERP was found (web search budget for the session was exhausted mid-pass, so Barbados budget speeches 2008-2010 were not searched). launched left blank.

can-qc-investor: no Quebec founding text read. Stored CIC evaluation (2014) dates the FEDERAL investor class to 1986 ('the IN class was only established in 1986'), not Quebec's own programme. Only agent sites (immigration.ca, cila.co) say Quebec's programme was created in 1986: leads only. The Quebec Gazette archive on publicationsduquebec.gouv.qc.ca found only later amendments (1997, 2000, 2005) and a 2000 decree on the business-aid programme financed by investor funds; the 1980s amendment to the Règlement sur la sélection des ressortissants étrangers (R.R.Q. 1981, c. M-23.1, r.2) adding the investor category was not found. launched left blank.

col-investor-visa: the resident-investor visa predates the oldest stored text (Res. 6045/2017). Read: Decreto 2107 de 2001 (Diario Oficial 44.576, 8 Oct 2001; Cancillería normograma), art. 90 'DE LA VISA DE RESIDENTE INVERSIONISTA'; it repealed Decreto 2371 of 27 Dec 1996, whose partial Cancillería extract (pr004) also has 'RESIDENTE INVERSIONISTA' (arts. 146-147). So the route existed by 1996 and the founding text is older still; not found (search budget exhausted). The real-estate route's origin (before 2017) not established either. Not stored, since neither is the founding text. launched left blank.

cri-inversionista: the investor category predates the stored 2012 Reglamento de Extranjería and Ley 8764 (2009); its founding text (likely under the earlier migration law or the pensionados/rentistas incentive regime) was not found. Ley 9996 (stored) has no history. SCIJ (pgrweb.go.cr) search pages are not reachable by plain URL, and the session's web search budget was exhausted. launched left blank.

che-lump-sum-taxation: neither the 1862 Vaud text nor the 1934 federal text (BBl 2011 6021 says 'der Bund seit 1934'; most likely the federal crisis levy decree) was found or read; the 1995 DBG PDF version is not in the fedlex filestore (HTML only).

cuw-investor-permit: the 2014 decree (stored) repeals a Ministerial Decree of 3 August 2009 no. 3672/MJ'09, which is the likely founding text; not found on immigrationcur.org (only the 2014 decree in Dutch and English is published, per the Wayback index of its uploads). Whether an even earlier Netherlands Antilles scheme existed was not checked. launched left empty.

cyp-golden-visa: legal basis found (Regulation 6(2), 1972). No founding text for the investor fast-track found: the 2023 criteria (fourth revision, 2 May 2023) do not say when the policy was first adopted, but accept resale contracts lodged before 07/05/2013, which suggests the scheme existed by 2013 and conflicts with the European Commission's 2016 (existing year event). The Audit Office special report (Nov 2023), which likely gives the history, is behind an Azure WAF JavaScript bot check on gov.cy/audit and was not read. launched left empty rather than following the doubtful 2016.

est-business-residence: launched set to the European Commission's year 2009 (secondary; event already stored). The founding text was not read: the Aliens Act passed 09.12.2009 is in force from 01.10.2010 (stored consolidated text, header), and residence permits for enterprise also existed under the 1993 Aliens Act; Riigi Teataja's site is a JavaScript application, so earlier versions (and the origin of the EUR 65,000 / EUR 16,000 thresholds, possibly the amendment in force 01.07.2012) could not be retrieved. If the Commission's 2009 is the 2009 Act's adoption, the in-force date under decision 14 would be 2010-10-01; a person should check.

tca-home-owner-permit: earliest text read is the Immigration Regulations (L.N. 28/2016, in force 1 April 2016, as revised 2021), regs 33-37. Whether a Home Owner's Permit existed under the pre-2016 Immigration Ordinance was not established (the 2012 government statement on the immigration law lists only the investor residence permit; gov.tc law library not navigable; no archived gov.tc page found). launched left empty; web search budget was exhausted during this pass.

fra-passeport-talent-investor: the Journal officiel text of loi n° 2016-274 and décret n° 2016-1456 (which fixes 1 Nov 2016) could not be read: Legifrance served a bot-check page (HTTP 403 'Just a moment...'), not bypassed. Used the Assemblée nationale final adopted text (TA 683) and the government's application-circular annex instead. Whether the pre-2016 'compétences et talents' card (abrogated 2016) already served investors was not checked.

ltu-investor-residence: when minimum investment amounts were first written into art. 45(1)(1) is not established: the 2026 consolidated text lists amendments only from 2014 (TAR), and the e-seimas list of historical consolidated versions loads by script and was not retrieved. The EUR 14,000/28,000 wording and the EUR 260,000 route date from Law XII-2609 (published 2016-09-19); an earlier LTL amount (EPRS lists LTL 50,000) was not traced to a text.

mne-property-residence: Službeni list CG 56/14 (publication date of the 2014 Law on Foreigners) not retrieved, so the in-force date (eighth day after publication) is not computable; launched uses the stated application date 1 April 2015. The 2008 Law on Foreigners (Sl. list CG 82/08) was not read, but the Government's 2014 memorandum calls the property ground new.
